study: One bounded query-only Qwen0.6 LoRA pilot over the frozen full IR catalog
status: Post-test exploratory; not a personalization rescue or corpus re-encoding.

data.selection: First50000 in the existing frozen100000 official-train fitting order; all covered fitting positives retained.
data.validation_role: Existing disjoint train-sourced query groups; previously inspected, diagnostic only, no checkpoint or recipe selection.
data.final_role: One frozen post-test exploratory evaluation, never resource or recipe admission.
data.query_rendering: Existing pinned Instruct/Query string and tokenizer special-token behavior, no chat template.
data.pooling: Pinned last-valid-token pooling, FP32 normalization, differentiable canonicalFP16 query rounding.
data.length_audit: All actual instructed strings, not a sample; report count/p50/p90/p99/max/overflow/real and padded token counts. Unexpected overflow fails preflight.
data.generation_metadata: N/A: static embedding contrastive inputs, not generated responses.

training.checkpoint_policy: Final completed epoch only; no validation-best or intermediate winner.
training.gradient_policy: Direct gradient-enabled transformer forward with use_cache=False; never SemanticEncoder.encode inference_mode.
training.loss: Per-query logsumexp over P union H union U minus logsumexp over all P, averaged equally across the actual optimizer block.

negatives.base_query_source: Existing pinned frozen-base fitting vectors, source and ordered query identities checked.
negatives.backend: Actual FAISS scalar-half on the existing validated shared partition
negatives.policy: Distinct fixed seed/query samples excluding all P and prior sampled H; once only, no refresh/in-batch negatives/held-out label blacklist.
negatives.truth: Retrieved and uniform alternatives are weak negatives, not exhaustive irrelevance.

requirements: zero-adapter fresh-base parity on identical groups
base weights and item bank unchanged
adapter optimizer RNG checkpoint reload and resumed-continuation agreement
all source token query negative and target-module identities
smoke.post_smoke: Discard smoke state and restart the fixed seed17 one-epoch recipe.

arms: same pinned base with final attached adapter
evaluation.groups: One immutable label-independent group partition, identical between arms and reused by every raw replay/timing context.
evaluation.retrieval: Exhaustive FP32 whole canonical item bank top1000, TF32 disabled.
evaluation.uncertainty: Paired original-query bootstrap20000 draws, seed20261011, pointwise95%, populations separate; no PrimaryB NI margin or qualification.
evaluation.timing: Raw tokenization/encoding and raw query to resident exact search; catalog loading outside the timer. Batch1 encoding is a cost diagnostic, not batch1 quality-latency.

memory.scope: Finite sampled benchmark-device observations; additional administrative context separately accounted, not unseen-peak guarantees.

stops.engineering_not_ready_by_two_hours: Stop as preflight/engineering incomplete; no resource escalation or new recipe.
stops.missing_or_incompatible_data: Data/preflight blocked, not method failure or permission to substitute final queries.
stops.epoch_or_required_evaluation_unfinished: Incomplete; no intermediate checkpoint selection or shortened outcome denominator.
stops.completed_null_or_regression: One finite asymmetric query-only recipe result, not evidence against all finetuning.
